hypothesis: 公開一次情報で確認できるaggregate customer concentrationだけでも、AVGOはNVDAよりmaterially大きいdownsideを持ち、対称な20% concentrated-customer revenue shockでAVGO-NVDAの5年expected IRR差を0.5pt以上悪化させる。

precommit_rule.use: 対称な20% concentrated-customer revenue shockでAVGOの相対5年expected IRR差がbenchmarkより0.5pt以上悪化し、公開されたaggregate concentrationだけでmaterialな追加downsideを確認できる。
precommit_rule.reject: 相対IRR差の悪化が0.5pt未満で、公開されたaggregate concentrationだけではAVGO固有のmaterialな追加downsideを支持しない。
precommit_rule.unverified: customer definition、period、revenue share、valuation dependencyのsource/identity/unit/as-ofが不足し、比較不能。

dependencies.note: AVGOに有利なpretax interest-savings upper-bound valuationをbaselineに使い、customer concentrationだけの追加効果を分離する。

broadcom.source: Broadcom Inc. Form 10-Q filed 2026-06-09, period ended 2026-05-03
broadcom.metric: aggregate sales to top five end customers through all channels
broadcom.additional_context: one semiconductor solutions distributor represented 42% of revenue, but distributor concentration is not treated as equivalent to end-customer demand concentration

nvidia.metric: three largest disclosed direct customers in first half FY2027

broadcom_ai_context.note: AI revenue mix is context only. The filing does not disclose the overlap between the top-five end-customer bucket and AI semiconductor revenue, so no overlap is guessed.

method.stress_definition: Apply the same proportional revenue reduction to each issuer's disclosed concentrated-customer bucket, hold the rest of revenue unchanged, and assume terminal FCF/equity value changes proportionally with total revenue. This is a transparent sensitivity, not a forecast.
method.comparability_warning: AVGO reports top-five end customers through all channels, while NVDA reports direct customers. The customer definitions are not identical. Therefore the test answers only whether disclosed aggregate shares alone support a material AVGO-specific penalty; it does not estimate true single-customer loss probability or AI-customer overlap.
no_silent_assumptions: Do not infer individual AVGO end-customer shares from the 45% aggregate.
Do not map Broadcom's 42% distributor directly to an economic end customer.
Do not infer overlap between Broadcom top-five end customers and AI semiconductor revenue.
Do not infer indirect-customer concentration for NVIDIA beyond issuer disclosures.

result.finding: 最新の比較可能な公開aggregate customer concentrationはAVGO top-five end customers約45%、NVDA disclosed top-three direct customers計44%で近い。対称な20% concentrated-bucket shockではAVGOのtotal revenue haircutは9.0%、NVDAは8.8%で、AVGO-NVDA expected-IRR差の追加悪化は0.0375ptに留まり、事前materiality閾値0.5ptを大幅に下回った。公開aggregate concentrationだけを根拠にAVGOへ大きな追加valuation penaltyを課す仮説はREJECT。

risk_metrics.reason: realized trading strategyではなくpoint-in-time fundamental concentration sensitivity。

decision_rule: AVGO customer concentrationを相対valuationで追加penaltyに使う場合、top-five aggregate 45%だけを根拠にmaterialなAVGO-specific penaltyを置かない。個別end-customer share、AI revenueとのoverlap、契約commitment、deployment timingなど独立一次情報が得られた場合のみ再評価する。
limitations: AVGO top-five end customersとNVDA direct customersは定義が異なるため完全なapples-to-apples比較ではない。
Broadcomの最新Q3 FY2026 8-KはAI semiconductor revenueを開示するが、top-five end-customer concentrationとのoverlapは開示しない。
NVIDIAはdirect customer concentrationを開示するが、indirect end-customer concentrationは推定を含み、同じ定義でAVGOと比較できない。
stressはconcentrated bucket全体が同率で減収する感応度であり、single-customer default/loss probabilityではない。
terminal FCF/equity valueをrevenueに比例させる単純stressであり、margin responseやcost mitigationを予測しない。
next_hypothesis: BroadcomのAI customer commitments、deployment timing、purchase/lease obligationsを一次情報でpoint-in-timeに固定し、公開aggregate customer concentrationでは捉えられないAI-specific demand downsideをcash-flow scenarioへ変換できるか。
